title: Meta-CoT: Hierarchical Chain-of-Thought for Image Editing
summary: A hierarchical reasoning framework that decomposes image editing instructions into structured triplets and five fundamental meta-tasks. It aligns multimodal large language models with diffusion outputs using reinforcement learning to achieve state-of-the-art generalization.
research_notes: Introduces CoT-Editing Consistency (CEC) Reward and Flow-GRPO to bridge the gap between model reasoning and pixel-level output.

evolution.summary: Accepted to CVPR 2026; released code, BAGEL-7B-MoT weights, and the 21-Tasks-Bench benchmark in April 2026.
